review_notes: Independently read the complete current proposal.json, functionality.md, fact-dispositions.json and link-dispositions.json. Both proposed writes address owned subjects and are supported; all other proposal collections are empty.

Verified the helper definition, Fall interrupt consumer, active neutral callback table and ABS macro against pinned foreign canonical source. No numeric table-slot gameplay mapping was inferred.

The proposed purpose correctly distinguishes callback dispatch from input-bit consumption or local airborne eligibility validation. The proposed state behavior accurately records priority, inclusive selection thresholds, strict facing guards, immediate NULL rejection without fallback, and the cached Fighter pointer's post-callback flag write.

Retained aerial-mapping claims describe dispatch integration and possible pre-callback facing reversal. Broader wiki timing, universal air-only restrictions and a turnaround path for Hi are not independently established or adopted.
